title: Telemetry privacy file (telemetry-privacy.yaml)
description: The classes of the telemetry fields of an app (docs/DESIGN.md section 9.6): every field of log message templates, every metric label and every span attribute that the app's code writes, with its class. A privacy review agent writes it from the code (step 5; in step 3 the agent that writes the code writes it), it lives in the archive (and later the repo), and a person confirms new fields in the publish approval. The ingestion pipeline (OpenTelemetry Collector processors) reads the confirmed classes: a non-empty `secret` value becomes the hidden-value marker, a `personal` value becomes a keyed pseudonym, before storage. A field that is not listed, or not confirmed, counts as `personal`. A metric label may not be `personal` or `secret` (validation fails). DRAFT for review (step 3 specify phase, docs/STEP3.md).

reason.description: Why this class (shown to the person who confirms; untrusted text).
